title: sanity-stack subagent and dev-sanity PASS wiring: sequential spawns, lock timeout, lean mode
target_boundary: agents: the sanity-stack subagent and dev-sanity's PASS path (link under the stack bead claim, then the close hook)
description:
## Goal
On a sanity PASS the sanity side links the checked PR as the new top of the phase stack under the stack bead's claim before the close hook runs; when more than one sanity task is open, or its own inline link failed, dev-sanity spawns the `sanity-stack` subagent, one spawn at a time in verdict order, each handling exactly one next-top layer. The race is the subagent's job: first PASS wins the top, the other dev gets `rebase-required` with no round counted; a lock timeout returns the holder and never blocks the team or escalates to a person. Governing text: `docs/requirements/sanity-stack.md` 1 to 13, `dev-sanity.md` 9, 10, 11, 13, 28, 29, 32, `team-lead.md` 22, 42, 43. Anchors: ANC-065, 066, 067, 068, 069, 071, 084, 086.

## Deliverables
1. `agents/sanity-stack.md`: a subagent of dev-sanity (tools Bash, Read), one next-top layer per spawn. Input, one fenced JSON object: `checked_bead`, `branch`, `pr_number`, `commit`, `stack_bead`, `budget` (`full` or `lean`), `timeout_s` (default 60). Procedure: claim the stack bead with `bd update <stack bead> --claim`, retrying every 5 s until `timeout_s`; under the lock and in this order with nothing between: re-read `layers` from the bead (never from the input), `git fetch origin`, choose the current top branch or `trunk` when the ledger is empty, then verify that baseline is an ancestor of `commit`; `full`: link every `linked: false` layer in order then this PR as the new top (`gh stack link <stack_number> <pr>`; the first stack from layers 0 and 1 with `--base <trunk>`), one `/sc-gh-stack-view`; `lean`: the ancestor check above is the only divergence check; append the first empty-ledger PASS as a singleton with base trunk, and preserve all unlinked entries during later catch-up; verify the PR base ref equals the top branch from one filtered REST pull list (`gh api repos/<o>/<r>/pulls?state=open&per_page=100 --jq` to number, base, head, sha, draft; never the raw body) and record `linked: false`; append the layer; write the metadata with `bd update --metadata @file.json`; release with `bd update <stack bead> --if-assignee "$ATM_IDENTITY" --status open --assignee ""`. Output, one fenced JSON object: `stacked` (new top, nullable `stack_number` for an initial singleton), `rebase_required`, `lock_timeout` (holder, claim time, holder's active task from `atm task list`) or `stack_failed`, with the evidence. GraphQL unavailable is detected and forces `lean`; a lean run makes no GraphQL call (ANC-069). Ancestor check fails: `rebase_required`, link nothing, write nothing (ANC-065). A link that fails for a stack reason is repaired with the `sc-gh-stack` recipes within this one layer, never rewriting a layer with children; unrecoverable: `stack_failed`, lock released, ledger unchanged. Under the lock, reconcile the hosted chain against existing ledger entries without replacing the ledger: preserve every `linked:false` entry; mark only proven links as linked; record hosted-only partial results only when uniquely attributable; ambiguity or conflicting ancestry returns `stack_failed` without ledger mutation. There is no automatic reclaim: a claim still held at `timeout_s` returns `lock_timeout`, and only the lead releases a stuck claim, by hand. dev-sanity waits for each spawn's result before the next, so no second writer of the same identity exists. The agent never refuses the task, never sends the dev a FAIL, never escalates to a person (ANC-068).
2. `agents/dev-sanity.md` PASS path (dev-sanity 28, sanity-stack.md 12, 13): one sanity task open: dev-sanity runs the procedure of deliverable 1 itself, inline, same order, same lock; more than one open, or its own inline link failed: it spawns `sanity-stack`, one spawn at a time in verdict order, never two in flight (ANC-066). `stacked`: run `atm-task-close.py --role sanity` with the stack result in the vars. A `not_reproducible` fix has no new PR: dev-sanity verifies the cited `file:line` at the commit and branch the assignment names (the current stack top, deliverable 4 of bj-1), spawns no `sanity-stack`, links nothing, and closes PASS with `outcome: not_reproducible` and no stack result. `rebase_required`: reopen the checked bead to the dev, send `rebase-required.xml.j2` on the dev's open task, leave `sanity_round` unchanged, keep the PASS in the ledger, close nothing (ANC-071). `lock_timeout`: keep the sanity task active, send the holder one plain message asking for the release, continue other sanity checks, re-spawn after the holder's reply or after another `timeout_s`; never refuse, never FAIL the dev, never a person (ANC-068). `stack_failed`: report to the lead as stack owner with the evidence and keep the task active (team-lead 22). `budget` is `lean` when GraphQL is unavailable or the agent is watching its token budget.
3. `agents/dev-sanity.md` items 9 and 10 (ANC-084..086): dev-sanity makes one Jev client call; retries, including an API-busy answer retried up to three times, belong to bj-4's client; the failure reason is the verbatim error, kept in the run's ledger row as kind `API_FAILURE`, never a FAIL verdict; every fallback use is logged with its verbatim error and said once in the close report. The LLM subagent spawn is fenced by a start and end timer whose elapsed is written as `llm_elapsed_s` to the ledger row. No class bead, outage bead, hold on re-dispatch, refusal citation or checker-defect side channel appears anywhere in the agent text.
4. `manifest.yaml` ships `agents/sanity-stack.md` and no longer lists `scripts/sanity-create-findings` (deleted in bj-1); `install.py` copies it like the other agents without a code change. Regenerate the block with `tests/gen_manifest.py`.
5. `CHANGELOG.md`: the phase entry for bj-1, bj-2 and bj-3 (close hook, stack bead and pour, sanity-stack), written here because this sprint lands after both.
6. Tests, `scripts/tests/test_agent_prompts.py`: the agent files contain the required phrases and none of the forbidden ones: `rg -n "class bead|outage bead|hold on re-dispatch|citation|checker-defect" agents` returns nothing; `sanity-stack.md` names `timeout_s`, `budget`, `lock_timeout`, `rebase_required`, `stack_failed`, `--claim`, `--if-assignee`; `dev-sanity.md` forbids a second spawn while one is in flight.

## Required Work
- Prompt text is minimal: a procedure, not an essay.

## This Sprint Does Not Close
- The lead's stack recipes (unstack, restack, land under the claim): the `sc-gh-stack` skill and `team-lead.md` 42 already state them; no script is added.

## Recovery and Retry
Recovery is driven by injected clock and command responses. It preserves ledger-only unlinked lean entries, reconciles only uniquely attributable hosted link events, and fails closed on ambiguity.

## Public Contract
sanity-stack input and result, one fenced JSON object each:
```json
{"checked_bead": "atm-bj-1", "branch": "sprint/bj-1-task-close-hook", "pr_number": 351, "commit": "<sha>",
 "stack_bead": "atm-phase-bj.stack", "budget": "full", "timeout_s": 60}
```
```json
{"result": "stacked", "top": {"branch": "...", "pr": 351, "head": "<sha>", "base": "...", "linked": true}, "stack_number": 7}
{"result": "rebase_required", "top": {"branch": "...", "head": "<sha>"}, "evidence": "origin/<top> is not an ancestor of <sha>"}
{"result": "lock_timeout", "holder": "<identity>", "claimed_at": "<iso>", "holder_task": "<task id or null>"}
{"result": "stack_failed", "evidence": "<command> [<exit>] <first stderr line>"}
```
Lock, under which the whole procedure runs:
```bash
bd update "$STACK" --claim --actor "$ATM_IDENTITY"                       # retry every 5 s until timeout_s
bd update "$STACK" --if-assignee "$ATM_IDENTITY" --metadata @layers.json --actor "$ATM_IDENTITY"   # the commit point; exit 13 on mismatch
bd update "$STACK" --if-assignee "$ATM_IDENTITY" --status open --assignee "" --actor "$ATM_IDENTITY"   # release; exit 13 on mismatch
```
Lean verification (no GraphQL):
```bash
gh api "repos/$OWNER/$REPO/pulls?state=open&per_page=100" --jq '.[] | {number, base: .base.ref, head: .head.ref, sha: .head.sha, draft}'
```

## Exact Targets
- new `plugins/atm-bd-orchestration/agents/sanity-stack.md`, `skills/atm-bd-orchestration/scripts/tests/test_agent_prompts.py`
- edited `plugins/atm-bd-orchestration/agents/dev-sanity.md`, `manifest.yaml`, `CHANGELOG.md`

## Dependency rationale
`must_follow` bj-1: consumes the sanity role's refusal of a PASS without `stacked` and the `rebase-required.xml.j2` template. `must_follow` bj-2: consumes `StackMetadata` (`trunk`, `stack_number`, `layers`) on the poured stack bead. The PR base is `sprint/bj-1-task-close-hook` or a descendant of it; the dev rebases onto the current top before the hook.
acceptance_criteria:
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] (ANC-066) `agents/dev-sanity.md` states: more than one open sanity task, or an inline link failure, spawns `sanity-stack`; one spawn at a time in verdict order; the close hook runs only after `stacked`.
- [ ] (ANC-065) `agents/sanity-stack.md` returns `rebase_required` and writes nothing when `origin/<top.branch>` is not an ancestor of `commit`; in a scratch run two branches cut from the same top that both pass sanity leave `layers` with the first as top and the second dev holding a `rebase-required` message on its open task.
- [ ] (ANC-067) after two links in the scratch run, `bd show atm-phase-x.stack --json` lists both layers in link order with `branch`, `pr`, `head`, `base`, `linked`, and the bead's assignee is empty.
- [ ] (ANC-068) with the stack bead claimed by another actor, a spawn with `timeout_s: 10` returns `lock_timeout` naming the holder, claim time and task at the injected logical deadline; `dev-sanity.md` keeps the task active, messages the holder once and re-spawns; `rg -n "escalate to (a )?(human|person)|refuse the task" agents/sanity-stack.md agents/dev-sanity.md` matches only the prohibition.
- [ ] (ANC-069) `agents/sanity-stack.md` lean procedure names the one REST pull list filtered to number, base, head, sha, draft and records `linked: false`; `rg -n graphql agents/sanity-stack.md` matches only the detection and the prohibition.
- [ ] (ANC-071) `rg -n sanity_round agents/dev-sanity.md` shows the rebase-required path leaving it unchanged.
- [ ] (ANC-084..086) dev-sanity performs one client call without a second retry loop; retry attempt counts and API_FAILURE reason are asserted by bj-4 injected client tests; `llm_elapsed_s` is named where the LLM spawn is timed.
- [ ] (team-lead 22) `agents/sanity-stack.md` sends `stack_failed` to the lead with the lock released and the ledger unchanged.
- [ ] `manifest.yaml` lists `agents/sanity-stack.md`; `install.py` into a scratch repository places `.claude/agents/sanity-stack.md`.

## Validation
- `just lint` and `just test` in the atm-bd-orchestration worktree.
- `python3 -m pytest plugins/atm-bd-orchestration/skills/atm-bd-orchestration/scripts/tests/test_agent_prompts.py -q`
- [ ] Recovery tests cover torn link before ledger write, existing unlinked lean entries, unrelated expired leases left untouched, ambiguous hosted chains, and a commit after the lead released the claim by hand failing with exit 13 and an unchanged ledger, using injected clock/runner inputs.
